title: HomeGuard Homeowners Policy Loss Settlement Condition: Other Structures at Full Value or Documented Cost
content:
**HomeGuard Homeowners Policy: loss settlement condition for other structures on a supplemental settlement.**

When the other-structures part of a HomeGuard claim is re-settled as a supplemental, the settled basis of the other structures is fixed as follows. The replacement-cost value and the deductible absorbed are those of the claim's other-structures settlement.

**(a) Small losses at full value.** When the other-structures replacement-cost value is at or below the tier's no-holdback threshold, the settled basis is the full replacement-cost value less the deductible absorbed.

**(b) Documented cost after a release.** When the replacement-cost value is above that threshold and a release of withheld depreciation already stands on the other-structures part of the claim, the settled basis is the smaller of (i) the replacement-cost value and (ii) the largest documented incurred cost on those releases, less the deductible absorbed.

**(c)** In any other situation this condition supplies no settled basis.

## The no-holdback threshold by package

| Package | No-holdback threshold (USD) |
|---|---|
| HomeGuard HO-3 Essential | 0 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | 1000 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | 2500 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | 1000 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | 2500 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | 10000 |

"At or below" includes equality: a replacement-cost value exactly equal to the threshold falls under (a), and a value one cent above it does not. On HO-3 Essential the threshold is 0, so any positive replacement-cost value is above it.

## Condition grid

| Replacement-cost value vs threshold | Depreciation release on the other-structures part | Settled basis |
|---|---|---|
| At or below | Any | Full replacement-cost value less deductible absorbed |
| Above | At least one release stands | Lower of replacement-cost value and largest documented incurred cost, less deductible absorbed |
| Above | None | Not supplied by this condition |

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

- HO-5 Signature, replacement-cost value 9000.00, deductible absorbed 1000.00: 9000.00 is at or below 10000, so the settled basis is 8000.00.
- HO-3 Premier, replacement-cost value 18000.00, deductible absorbed 1000.00. Two releases stand, with documented incurred costs of 15500.00 and 16200.00. The largest is 16200.00, lower than 18000.00, so the settled basis is 15200.00.
- The same, but with a documented incurred cost of 19500.00 on the release: the replacement-cost value of 18000.00 is the lower, so the settled basis is 17000.00.
